bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 151K subscribers. Nothing to buy from you.
beats.text: You stream ICT live almost every trading day, your streams pull 15,000 to 24,000 views, and lumitraders.com promises “No paid walls”. Apart from the book and the desk mat, the traders who want your help have no way to pay you for it.

beats.title: 7,583 traders in your Discord.
beats.text: 984 of them were online when I checked. On Instagram, one “Comment LUMI” post for your 10AM Open Break lesson pulled 161 comments. These people already learn ICT from you every day.

beats.title: The money from your teaching goes through someone else.
beats.text: Apex, Lucid and funded.now codes sit in your bio, your thumbnails and your streams. That income depends on their deals, not on how good your teaching is, and it ends with a sign-up instead of a conversation with you.

stats.label: calls with your most serious viewers

beats.title: “I promised no paid walls.” Keep that promise.
beats.text: The Discord stays free, the streams stay free, the book stays as it is. The mentorship is a separate, optional step for the few who want personal help: one page, a short application and a call.
beats.quote: “I keep everything honest — the good days, the tough days, and all the lessons that come with trading.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

mechanism.title: ICT, the simple way
mechanism.body: No fancy jargon, no overcomplicated explanations. You learn the full ICT day trading model step by step, trade it at the open with a clear plan, and manage risk so one trade can't end your account. In the mentorship, Dasha reviews your trades with you until the model makes sense in real time.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades or chart screenshots ready, wins and losses.

One note: I never DM you first, and nobody on my team will ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Dasha

preCallEmails.subject: ICT doesn't have to be complicated
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders don't struggle with ICT because it's too hard. They struggle because they try to use every concept at once.

In the mentorship we keep it simple: bias, liquidity, one entry at the open, and risk rules that protect the account.

On the call we'll look at where it breaks for you today.

Dasha

preCallEmails.subject: "I already watch the streams"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then you know how I trade
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, then you've seen how I trade every day.

The mentorship is for when watching isn't enough anymore: I go through your own trades with you, so you see exactly where your execution is off.

The streams and the Discord stay free. If you're not sure you need more, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Dasha

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the mentorship works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Dasha

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Dasha's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Dasha

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Dasha
